name: ParametricNoise procedural fields (Perlin, simplex, Worley, curl), gaussianized
plain: Generates a lattice noise field per channel (Perlin, simplex, Worley cellular or curl of a potential), with octaves, persistence and lacunarity, from a seed derived from all widgets. It then maps the field to an exact Gaussian histogram by rank (each pixel's rank becomes the matching normal quantile) and renormalizes, which keeps spatial structure but makes the marginal standard normal. Curl uses one global scale for all channels; the docstring warns that gaussianizing a curl field breaks its divergence-free property.
math:
Symbols: f raw procedural field per (batch,channel) plane of n pixels; rank_k position in sorted order.
f = Σ_o persistence^o · noise(scale·lacunarity^o) for the chosen mode.
gaussianize: u_k=(rank_k+0.5)/n; y_k=Φ⁻¹(u_k).
out = N(y) per channel (curl: one global scale).

props.params: mode perlin|simplex|worley|curl, scale, octaves, persistence, lacunarity, tileable, worley_n, worley_edges, distance_metric, gaussianize on
